config.description: Figma personal access token with file_content:read; ingest_board reads the board with it.

config.label: API key of the OpenAI-compatible provider in LLM_BASE_URL
config.description: API key of the OpenAI-compatible provider in LLM_BASE_URL. Needed with LLM_BASE_URL for image interpretation and answers; a local server without sign-in needs any non-empty value.

config.label: API root of an OpenAI-compatible provider, for example https://openrouter
config.description: API root of an OpenAI-compatible provider, for example https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. Needed with LLM_API_KEY for image interpretation and answers.

config.label: Private local cache root; v4 snapshots are stored in a subdirectory
config.description: Private local cache root; v4 snapshots are stored in a subdirectory.

config.label: Absolute path of an env file to load; variables already set win
config.description: Absolute path of an env file to load; variables already set win. The server does not read a .env from its working directory.
